channel.title: AI GridWatch — Florida data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for Florida, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Lake County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 90-day moratorium on large-scale data center applications in unincorporated areas; approved unanimously.

item.title: Jackson County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Permanent ban on data centers in unincorporated areas; originally a moratorium rescinded June 9, amended to full ban adopted unanimously 5-0.

item.title: Walton County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Permanent ban on data centers and large-load centers (50+ MW); approved unanimously 5-0.

item.title: Wakulla County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Permanent ban on data centers; unanimous vote despite county attorney cautioning that indefinite ban is riskier than moratorium.

item.title: Holmes County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: One-year moratorium on data centers and large-load facilities in unincorporated areas (Ordinance No. 2026-23).

item.title: Bay County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Six-month moratorium on AI data centers requiring 5+ MW in unincorporated areas; approved unanimously.

item.title: Leon County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 18-month moratorium on large-scale data centers and large-load customer facilities in unincorporated areas; approved unanimously.

item.title: Hernando County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: One-year moratorium on data center applications, permitting, and rezoning; approved unanimously.

item.title: Levy County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: One-year moratorium on large-scale data centers; effective Oct 1, 2026 through Sep 30, 2027; nearly 100 residents attended.

item.title: Putnam County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: One-year moratorium on medium and large-scale data center projects; approved unanimously on second reading.

item.title: Collier County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Zoning-in-progress measure preventing new data center applications while county develops regulations.

item.title: Edgewater: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: Charter amendment to permanently ban data centers placed on November 2026 ballot; commissioners voted unanimously to place measure.

item.title: Hillsborough County: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: County attorney directed to draft moratorium ordinance; cannot take effect until Oct 1, 2027 due to SB 180.

item.title: Hendry County: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: Expected to halt data center proposals until county code is updated to reflect state law (SB 484); outcome not confirmed.

item.title: St. Johns County: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: Commissioners reached consensus to direct county attorney to prepare formal moratorium proposal; not yet enacted.

item.title: Miami Lakes: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: Town Council member introduced item to develop ordinance defining and prohibiting data centers as principal use.

item.title: Tallahassee: data center moratorium — Rejected
item.description: City Commission rejected data center moratorium/ban 3-2; city manager said existing zoning codes already prevent data centers.

item.title: Indiantown: data center moratorium — Rejected
item.description: Village Council voted 4-1 against resolution to temporarily pause large-scale data center applications.

item.title: Marion County: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: Planning and Zoning Commission voted unanimously to recommend a 12-month moratorium on new data centers, cryptocurrency mining and related facilities after a packed public hearing. Goes to the Board of County Commissioners for a second public hearing on Sept 15, 2026; not adopted yet. Commissioners had earlier directed staff to prepare a 12-month pause rather than the six months first suggested.

item.title: Orange County: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: Vice Mayor Kelly Martinez Semrad asked the county commission to consider a moratorium of at least one year on new AI data center applications; the board takes it up Sept 15, 2026. County land development code has no data center definition, so the use is implicitly allowed in industrial districts. Proposal calls for study of water, energy capacity, zoning and community character.

item.title: Clay County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Board of County Commissioners voted 4-1 to adopt a one-year moratorium on data center rezoning, permits, and site plans; Commissioner Compere sole no vote; staff to research potential impacts on water and infrastructure

item.title: Nassau County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Board of County Commissioners adopted Ordinance 2026-044, a 12-month moratorium on acceptance, review, or approval of applications for development permits, rezoning, or site plans for data centers, data processing, data mining, or cryptocurrency mining; county established a Fact-Finding Committee on Data Center Development; prompted by NextNRG's 1,600-acre lease option near Jacksonville International Airport

item.title: Madison County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium on construction and permitting of large-scale data centers. Unanimous vote.

item.title: Martin County: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: Commissioners voted 4-1 to direct staff to return with a proposal for a one-year moratorium on data centers. A moratorium would require two public hearings before adoption. No formal moratorium ordinance has been enacted yet.

item.title: North Port: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: City Commission voted 4-1 on first reading of an 18-month moratorium on data center applications, following 7 hours of public comment with nearly all speakers opposed. Final vote expected September 22, 2026. Triggered by a data center application filed just hours before the moratorium discussion.

item.title: Volusia County: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: County Council directed staff to draft a permanent ban on large-scale data centers in unincorporated areas, moving beyond an initial six-month moratorium proposal. The ban ordinance must go through the Planning Commission and two public hearings before formal adoption. New data center applications are not being accepted in the interim.
